entries.summaryZh: 1968年1月至2月，越南战争春节攻势期间，北越军队与越共对南越首都西贡发动协同进攻，攻击总统府、美军设施与电台等重要目标。战斗持续数周，联军最终击退进攻，但西贡部分城区受损，美军大使馆院内一度被突入。此役与顺化战役一同成为春节攻势的象征。
entries.summaryEn: In January and February 1968, during the Tet Offensive of the Vietnam War, North Vietnamese and Viet Cong forces attacked Saigon in a coordinated assault on the presidential palace, American installations and radio stations. The fighting lasted weeks and the attackers were finally repelled, though parts of the city were damaged and the US embassy compound was briefly breached.
entries.significanceZh: 西贡之战是春节攻势中政治象征意义最强的一战，其冲击改变了美国国内对战争的判断。
entries.significanceEn: Saigon was the most politically charged battle of the Tet Offensive and its impact shifted American public judgement of the war.

entries.summaryZh: 2006年3月至11月，伊拉克战争期间，美军与伊拉克安全部队在安巴尔省首府拉马迪与叛乱武装争夺城市控制权。联军在城内设立多处战斗前哨，并争取部族长老支持，促成安巴尔觉醒；当年11月联军基本控制拉马迪。此役是伊拉克战争转向与部族合作的关键转折之一。
entries.summaryEn: From March to November 2006, during the Iraq War, American and Iraqi forces fought insurgents for control of Ramadi, capital of Anbar Province. The coalition set up combat outposts in the city and courted tribal leaders, helping to produce the Anbar Awakening; by November the city was largely under coalition control.
entries.significanceZh: 拉马迪之战促成安巴尔觉醒，是伊拉克战争中美军转向依靠部族力量、扭转安巴尔局势的关键一役。
entries.significanceEn: Ramadi produced the Anbar Awakening and marked the turn towards tribal alliance that reversed the insurgency's hold on Anbar.

entries.summaryZh: 2002年4月1日至11日，第二次大起义期间，以色列军队在防卫墙行动中进攻约旦河西岸杰宁难民营。巴方武装事先布设大量爆炸装置，以军巷战中转而大量使用装甲推土机。武装人员4月11日开始投降，以军4月18日撤出，双方统计共约52至54名巴勒斯坦人和23名以军士兵死亡。
entries.summaryEn: From 1 to 11 April 2002, during the Second Intifada, Israeli forces attacked the Jenin refugee camp in the West Bank as part of Operation Defensive Shield. Palestinian militants had booby-trapped the camp and Israel turned increasingly to armoured bulldozers; the fighters began surrendering on 11 April and Israeli troops withdrew on 18 April.
entries.significanceZh: 杰宁之战是第二次大起义中最激烈的城市战之一，围绕伤亡规模与屠杀指控的争议影响至今。
entries.significanceEn: Jenin was one of the fiercest urban battles of the Second Intifada, and the dispute over casualty figures and massacre allegations still resonates.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前165年9月前后，马加比起义期间，犹大·马加比率起义军在埃茅斯附近迎战塞琉古帝国军队。起义军连夜行军突袭敌军营地，趁大批士兵外出之机将其击溃，并缴获大量物资与武器。此役是马加比起义中一次重要的胜利，为随后清剿塞琉古驻军与收复耶路撒冷创造了条件。
entries.summaryEn: Around September 165 BC, during the Maccabean revolt, Judas Maccabeus and his rebels met a Seleucid force near Emmaus. Marching by night, the rebels surprised the camp while many soldiers were absent and routed it, seizing valuables and weapons. It was an important victory that prepared the way for clearing Seleucid garrisons.
entries.significanceZh: 埃茅斯之战以夜袭取胜，为马加比人随后肃清塞琉古驻军、收复耶路撒冷奠定了基础。
entries.significanceEn: Emmaus was won by a night surprise and prepared the Maccabean recovery of Jerusalem from its Seleucid garrison.

entries.summaryZh: 1810年11月7日，玻利维亚独立战争期间，布宜诺斯艾利斯第一执政委员会派出的革命军在苏帕恰击败西班牙殖民军队。这是革命军对保王党取得的首场决定性胜利，上秘鲁部分地区由此一度归附布宜诺斯艾利斯。此役鼓舞了拉普拉塔地区的独立运动，但上秘鲁的控制权此后仍反复易手。
entries.summaryEn: On 7 November 1810, during the Bolivian War of Independence, the republican army sent by the Primera Junta of Buenos Aires defeated the Spanish colonial forces at Suipacha in Upper Peru. It was the first decisive defeat of the Royalists by republican forces and briefly brought parts of Upper Peru under Buenos Aires.
entries.significanceZh: 苏帕恰之战是拉普拉塔地区革命军对西班牙保王党的首场决定性胜利，推动了南美独立运动的士气。
entries.significanceEn: Suipacha was the first decisive republican victory over the Royalists in the Rio de la Plata region and lifted the independence movement's morale.

entries.summaryZh: 1813年11月11日，1812年战争期间，英军与加拿大民兵在圣劳伦斯河畔的克莱斯勒农场击退试图进攻蒙特利尔的美国军队。美军损失惨重后撤退，圣劳伦斯河战役随之失败。此役与沙托盖战役一同保住了蒙特利尔，也巩固了英属北美对圣劳伦斯河补给线的控制。
entries.summaryEn: On 11 November 1813, during the War of 1812, British regulars and Canadian militia repelled an American force trying to advance on Montreal at Crysler's Farm on the Saint Lawrence. The Americans suffered heavy losses and withdrew, ending the Saint Lawrence campaign; with Chateauguay it saved Montreal and kept the supply line secure.
entries.significanceZh: 克莱斯勒农场之战与沙托盖战役一同挫败美军1813年的圣劳伦斯河战役，保住了蒙特利尔与补给线。
entries.significanceEn: Crysler's Farm and Chateauguay together defeated the American Saint Lawrence campaign of 1813 and saved Montreal.

entries.summaryZh: 1813年6月6日，1812年战争期间，英军在斯托尼溪夜袭美军营地，俘获两名美军将领，迫使美军放弃对安大略湖西端的推进并撤往四十英里溪。此役规模不大，却遏止了美军当年在上加拿大的攻势，稳定了尼亚加拉半岛的英军防线，被视为战争中的一次重要转折。
entries.summaryEn: On 6 June 1813, during the War of 1812, a British night attack on the American camp at Stoney Creek captured two American generals and forced the Americans to abandon their advance on the western end of Lake Ontario. The small action checked the American offensive in Upper Canada and steadied the British line on the Niagara peninsula.
entries.significanceZh: 斯托尼溪之战遏止了美军1813年对上加拿大的攻势，是尼亚加拉战场态势逆转的起点。
entries.significanceEn: Stoney Creek checked the American offensive in Upper Canada in 1813 and began the reversal of fortunes on the Niagara front.

entries.summaryZh: 1898年8月13日，美西战争末期，美军在菲律宾革命军配合下进攻马尼拉，西班牙守军在双方事先默契下进行了假战之后投降，以避免城市被毁并把控制权交给美军而非菲律宾人。此役结束了西班牙在菲律宾的统治，但菲律宾人未能入城，美菲之间的紧张随之上升。
entries.summaryEn: On 13 August 1898, at the end of the Spanish-American War, American forces with Philippine revolutionary support attacked Manila; the Spanish commander had arranged a mock battle with the Americans so that the city surrendered to them rather than to the Filipinos and was spared destruction. The battle ended Spanish rule in the Philippines.
entries.significanceZh: 马尼拉之战以假战方式结束西班牙在菲律宾的统治，同时埋下了美菲冲突的种子。
entries.significanceEn: Manila ended Spanish rule in the Philippines through a staged battle and planted the seeds of the Philippine-American conflict.

entries.summaryZh: 1811年1月17日，墨西哥独立战争期间，伊达尔戈等率约十万起义军在瓜达拉哈拉以东的卡尔德隆桥迎战卡列哈指挥的西班牙皇家军队。起义军被击溃，伊达尔戈等人随后被俘处死，独立战争第一阶段就此结束。此役也是西半球独立战争中伤亡最惨重的交战之一。
entries.summaryEn: On 17 January 1811, during the Mexican War of Independence, the insurgent army of about 100,000 under Hidalgo met the Royalist forces of Calleja at the Calderon Bridge east of Guadalajara. The insurgents were routed and Hidalgo was captured and executed soon afterwards, ending the first stage of the war.
entries.significanceZh: 卡尔德隆桥之战结束了墨西哥独立战争的第一阶段，起义军主力被摧毁，运动转入游击阶段。
entries.significanceEn: Calderon Bridge ended the first stage of the Mexican War of Independence, destroyed the insurgent army and drove the movement into guerrilla warfare.

entries.summaryZh: 2015年底至2016年2月，伊拉克军队在国际联盟空袭支援下发起反攻，从伊斯兰国手中夺回安巴尔省首府拉马迪。联军经过两个半月的战斗于2016年2月收复该城，其间空袭超过850次。拉马迪在战斗中遭到严重破坏，据估计全城约九成建筑受损，是伊拉克战争中破坏最严重的城市之一。
entries.summaryEn: From late 2015 to February 2016 Iraqi forces, supported by coalition air strikes, counter-attacked to retake Ramadi in Anbar Province from Islamic State. After two and a half months of fighting the city was recaptured in February 2016, with more than 850 air strikes flown; Ramadi was left among the most damaged cities of the Iraq war.
entries.significanceZh: 拉马迪收复战是伊拉克军队2015年后首次夺回省会城市，标志打击伊斯兰国战事的转折。
entries.significanceEn: The recapture of Ramadi was the first provincial capital Iraq retook after 2015 and marked a turning point against Islamic State.
